'wrong@example.com', 'password': 'wrongpass'}, content_type='application/json') self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 401) def test_register_success(self): response = self.client.post(reverse('register'), {'email': 'new@example.com', 'password': 'newpass', 'name': 'New User'}, content_type='application/json') self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201) def test_register_failure(self): response = self.client.post(reverse('register'), {'email': 'test@example.com', 'password': 'newpass', 'name': 'New User'}, content_type='application/json') self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400) myapp/migrations/__init__.py To run the server, execute the following command: ```bash python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:5000 ``` This will start the
